# Support

## Where to ask

- **A question about using the vault:** read [`FAQ.md`](FAQ.md) first, then ask in [Discussions, Q&A](https://github.com/erikunha/vault-of-loci/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **An idea you want to talk through:** [Discussions, Ideas](https://github.com/erikunha/vault-of-loci/discussions/categories/ideas).
- **Something you made with the vault:** share it in [Show and tell](https://github.com/erikunha/vault-of-loci/discussions/categories/show-and-tell).
- **Something does not work as described:** open a "Bug report" issue with the steps and the output of `python3 -I 90_System/Scripts/run_checks.py`.
- **An idea or content you want to add:** open an "Improvement" or "Content proposal" issue.
- **A security problem:** report it privately, as [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) explains. Never in a public issue.

## What to include

Your Obsidian version, the agent you use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot or another), what you did, what you expected and what happened. Leave out personal notes, keys and anything from a `.env` file or a plugin `data.json`.

## What to expect

This is a project maintained in spare time. Answers come when the maintainer can, usually within a week. A clear question with the steps to reproduce it gets answered first.
